pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large-scale polygonal dark regions with high-contrast, jagged edge gradients. Geometric complexity increases on the lower flank where patches transition to smaller, irregular stellate and amoeboid shapes with softer pixel-edge transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space lattice of light-colored pelage. Primary pathways on the neck show consistent pixel width, transitioning to a more diffuse, wider network on the posterior flank. Multiple high-valence junction nodes connect these pathways across the visible surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude silhouette of dark pixels against the background, representing the mane. Individual hair clusters create a micro-serrated 1D contour along the dorsal line of the neck.
